meta.description: Spec v0.3 section 11 defaults that are not in the LocoLabo TCO data pack. Every record carries status and a note. Statuses: sourced (pack or published), estimated (pack estimate), assumed (this spec, verify before a report).

fx.usd_aud.label: Exchange rate USD to AUD
fx.usd_aud.source: tco-data-pack conversion notes (AUD columns in pricing CSVs)
fx.usd_aud.note: The pack converts USD list prices at 1.54 and asks that the rate be treated as a parameter, not a constant.

power.inference_factor.label: Inference draw as share of nameplate
power.inference_factor.note: Text generation is bandwidth bound; nameplate is a ceiling. Errs against local AI, the safe direction.

power.cpu_offload_w.label: Extra system draw while the CPU offloads tokens
power.cpu_offload_w.note: Hybrid and CPU-only placements push CPU, RAM and board well above idle.

power.pue_single_user.label: Power usage effectiveness, single user
power.pue_single_user.note: A room in a house has no datacentre overhead.

power.pue_small_business.label: Power usage effectiveness, small business 2 to 20

power.pue_small_business_21.label: Power usage effectiveness, small business 21 to 200

electricity.tou_offpeak_start_hour.label: Off-peak window start hour
electricity.tou_offpeak_start_hour.note: Off-peak 21:00 to 07:00 assumed; check against the published schedule.

electricity.tou_offpeak_end_hour.label: Off-peak window end hour
electricity.tou_offpeak_end_hour.note: Off-peak 21:00 to 07:00 assumed; check against the published schedule.

electricity.demand_charge_aud_per_kw_mon.label: Demand charge, contestable supply
electricity.demand_charge_aud_per_kw_mon.note: Contestable tariff only. Mid of the published 8 to 20 band.

ownership.residual_share.label: Residual value at end of life
ownership.residual_share.note: Off by default. When on, credited linearly at end of life.

ownership.hardware_setup_aud.label: Paid-help setup, one-off
ownership.hardware_setup_aud.note: Single user and small business, only when paid help is on.

admin.hours_single_user_per_month.label: DIY admin hours, single user
admin.hours_single_user_per_month.note: DIY assumed, costed only if the user turns it on.

admin.hours_per_box_per_month.label: Admin hours per owned box per month
admin.hours_per_box_per_month.note: Applies from the 21 to 200 band up.

admin.hours_server_per_month.label: Admin hours per server per month, enterprise

memory.runtime_gb.label: Runtime overhead
memory.runtime_gb.note: Inference engine, CUDA context and scratch.

memory.kv_base_gb_per_ktoken.label: KV cache base per 1k tokens
memory.kv_base_gb_per_ktoken.note: Generic grouped-query attention fit, about 0.11 GB per 1k at 8B combined with the size term.

memory.kv_per_b_gb_per_ktoken.label: KV cache per 1k tokens per billion parameters
memory.kv_per_b_gb_per_ktoken.note: Overestimates many MoE models, which errs conservative.

memory.gpu_usable_share.label: Usable share of VRAM
memory.gpu_usable_share.note: GPU-only placement requires memory need within n cards times this.

memory.os_reserve_gb.label: OS reserve from system RAM in hybrid placement
memory.os_reserve_gb.note: Hybrid capacity is GPU VRAM plus RAM minus this reserve.

memory.unified_addressable_share.label: GPU-addressable share of unified memory
memory.unified_addressable_share.note: Unified placement capacity is pool times this.

speed.eta_cpu.label: Memory efficiency, CPU offload path
speed.eta_cpu.note: Not given in the spec. Chosen so T3 (30B MoE, share 0.70, DDR4 50 GB/s) lands at about 35 tok/s.

speed.eta_low_factor.label: Low band efficiency factor
speed.eta_low_factor.note: Band spread around the mid eta of each size point.

speed.eta_high_factor.label: High band efficiency factor
speed.eta_high_factor.note: Band spread around the mid eta of each size point.

speed.moe_gpu_bonus.label: MoE attention layers kept on GPU when weights spill
speed.moe_gpu_bonus.note: Only when the GPU share is below one.

speed.layer_split_factor.label: Multi-GPU layer split speed factor
speed.layer_split_factor.note: One point zero for a single card. Lets a bigger model fit but does not add single-stream speed.

speed.prefill_multiplier_gpu_modern.label: Prefill to decode ratio, modern GPU

speed.prefill_multiplier_gpu_legacy.label: Prefill to decode ratio, legacy GPU

speed.prefill_multiplier_hybrid.label: Prefill to decode ratio, hybrid
speed.prefill_multiplier_hybrid.note: CPU side is much slower at prefill.

speed.prefill_multiplier_cpu.label: Prefill to decode ratio, CPU only

speed.prefill_multiplier_unified.label: Prefill to decode ratio, unified memory

demand.peak_hour_share.label: Share of daily queries in the busiest hour

price_change.api_per_year.label: API price change per year
price_change.api_per_year.note: Cloud token prices have fallen; direction could reverse.

price_change.rental_per_year.label: Rental price change per year
price_change.rental_per_year.note: Marketplace rates drift down with GPU supply.

price_change.hardware_per_year.label: Hardware repurchase price change per year
price_change.hardware_per_year.note: Applies to the end-of-life repurchase only.

thinking.high.label: Thinking effort, high
thinking.high.note: Deep reasoning. Costs cloud money and allowance, costs local time.

verbosity.cloud.label: Cloud model verbosity multiplier
verbosity.cloud.note: Separate from the local efficiency factor.

subscriptions.window_h.label: Subscription reset window
subscriptions.window_h.note: The least certain input in the model. Flagged next to every subscription figure.

subscriptions.base_allowance_tokens.label: Base allowance per window
subscriptions.base_allowance_tokens.note: On the Best class. Not published by providers; replace with your own experience.

subscriptions.weekly_cap_windows.label: Weekly cap in full windows
subscriptions.weekly_cap_windows.note: Divided by days per week for a daily cap.

subscriptions.multiplier_previous.label: Allowance multiplier, Previous class
subscriptions.multiplier_previous.note: Older class is cheaper to serve.

subscriptions.multiplier_cheap.label: Allowance multiplier, Cheap class
subscriptions.multiplier_cheap.note: Small models are cheapest to serve.

api.cache_discount.label: Cached input token discount
api.cache_discount.note: Cached input costs a tenth of full price.

api.cached_share_agentic.label: Cached input share, agentic
api.cached_share_agentic.note: Agent loops re-read the same context.

api.previous_ratio.label: Previous class price as share of Best
api.previous_ratio.note: One generation back at about 0.6 of frontier prices.

fit.min_speed_tps.label: Minimum acceptable speed per user
fit.min_speed_tps.note: Below this, reading speed becomes the bottleneck.

explorer.budget_aud.label: Explorer budget
explorer.budget_aud.note: Auto mode ignores it and finds the cheapest build that meets demand.

hardware.extra_gpu_aud.label: Extra GPU cost beyond the first

hardware.band_price_small_modern_aud_per.label: Band price, small modern
hardware.band_price_small_modern_aud_per.note: Secondhand market. All AUD/GB values need re-pricing.

rental.sessions_per_day.label: Rental sessions per day
rental.sessions_per_day.note: Undefined in the spec; a morning and an afternoon stint.

rental.eta.label: Rented card memory efficiency
rental.eta.note: Modern datacentre or high-end consumer cards.

rental.bandwidth_48_share.label: Bandwidth of the 48 GB class as share of 24 GB
rental.bandwidth_48_share.note: Two consumer cards with a layer split.

gst.rate.label: Goods and services tax rate
gst.rate.note: Applied to overseas digital services when the display shows figures including GST.

value_of_time.aud_per_hour.label: Value of waiting time
value_of_time.aud_per_hour.note: Off by default because it can dominate every other cost.

demand.agent_tasks_per_day.label: Agent tasks per day when agents are on
demand.agent_tasks_per_day.note: Each task uses the agentic profile.

agentic.cacheable_share.label: Agentic input that is cacheable
agentic.cacheable_share.note: Used by the API cache share.

fit.context_default_k.label: Default context for local configurations
fit.context_default_k.note: Raised from 8k so the Analysis/RAG task (10k input) fits.

subscriptions.window_burst_time_share.label: Burst share of a subscription window (time)
subscriptions.window_burst_time_share.note: Interactive work arrives in sessions: this fraction of the window carries most of the tokens. You sit down, iterate, hit the cap, then wait for reset.

subscriptions.window_burst_load_share.label: Burst share of a subscription window (tokens)
subscriptions.window_burst_load_share.note: Share of each window's demand arriving in the burst fraction.

tasks.session_tolerance_min.label: Session tolerance for one meaningful task
tasks.session_tolerance_min.note: Max wall-clock time for one interactive task (generation plus any mid-task reset waiting) before the user perceives the option as unusable for real work. Past this, the task is not completable in a sitting.

platforms.label: Unified-memory mini PC
platforms.note: Complete box with a GPU-addressable share of the pool.

platforms.label: 4-GPU server
platforms.note: Available in the small business 21+ band and enterprise.

platforms.label: 8-GPU server
platforms.note: Available in the small business 21+ band and enterprise.

gpu_bands.label: Small modern (6 to 16 GB)
gpu_bands.note: Bandwidth and watts from the picker and power files (sourced/estimated). AUD/GB assumed, needs re-pricing.

gpu_bands.label: Large modern (24 GB)
gpu_bands.note: Bandwidth and watts from the picker (sourced). AUD/GB assumed.

gpu_bands.label: Flagship consumer
gpu_bands.note: New market. Picker price bracket for these cards is a floor (spec 15 item 2), hence band pricing.

gpu_bands.label: Legacy server
gpu_bands.note: Bandwidth and watts from the picker (sourced). The Tesla M40 benchmark anomaly (spec 15 item 3) is not referenced here.

gpu_bands.label: Datacentre
gpu_bands.note: Priced per size point (48 GB at 270, 80 GB at 625 AUD/GB). Verify.

rental_classes.label: 24 GB (4090 class)
rental_classes.note: The rent-vs-own comparison in its purest form.

rental_classes.label: 48 GB (2 x 24 GB)
rental_classes.note: Bandwidth is the 24 GB class times rental.bandwidth_48_share; two cards in a layer split.

subscription_tiers.label: Free
subscription_tiers.note: Allowance assumed and does NOT take the model-class multiplier: free tiers meter aggressively whatever model they serve. With the class multiplier applied, Free absorbed a whole Typical user's day, which is not how free tiers behave.

subscription_tiers.label: Pro (5x)
subscription_tiers.source: tco-data-pack cloud_subscription_pricing.csv (Claude Max row, the pack's 5x tier)
subscription_tiers.note: Price estimated, multiplier from the tier definition.

subscription_tiers.label: Max (20x)
subscription_tiers.note: Missing from the pack (spec 15 item 5). Price assumed at 2x Pro.

subscription_tiers.label: Business
subscription_tiers.source: tco-data-pack cloud_subscription_pricing.csv (ChatGPT Team row); multiplier assumed

subscription_tiers.label: Enterprise
subscription_tiers.source: tco-data-pack cloud_subscription_pricing.csv (ChatGPT Enterprise row); multiplier assumed

api_classes.label: Best
api_classes.derive: mean of frontier rows in cloud_api_pricing.csv (AUD)
api_classes.note: Mean of frontier rows. Verify against provider pricing pages.

api_classes.label: Previous
api_classes.note: One generation back at 0.6 of Best.

api_classes.label: Cheap
api_classes.derive: mean of small rows in cloud_api_pricing.csv (AUD)

api_classes.label: Premium
api_classes.note: Verify; premium-tier pricing has moved (spec 15 item 4). Optional row.

api_classes.label: Budget offshore
api_classes.note: Data sovereignty considerations differ. Optional row, sensitivity flag.

quality_targets.label: High
quality_targets.hw_hint: 2 x 24 GB, or 48 GB+, or GPU + large RAM (MoE)

quality_targets.label: Frontier
quality_targets.hw_hint: Datacentre GPUs or large unified memory; organisations only
quality_targets.note: Assumes large open models land near the previous cloud generation. The UI says so.

model_ladder.note: Budget-only mode returns a rung from this ladder, never an in-between size.

usage_presets.label: Workday + overnight agents
usage_presets.note: Agent tasks use demand.agent_tasks_per_day when the preset enables agents.

usage_modes.label: Documents
usage_modes.basis: 50 percent document summary, 30 percent analysis/RAG, 20 percent writing
usage_modes.note: Status A. Task ids match workload_profiles.csv ids.

usage_modes.label: Agentic
usage_modes.basis: 20 steps x 15,000 context input (70 percent cacheable) + 800 output per step
usage_modes.note: About 300,000 input and 16,000 output tokens per task.

cloud_efficiency_factors.note: Combined factor for cloud classes. Best is the baseline.

sensitivity_rules.note: Vetoed options stay visible, greyed, with the reason. Internal flags only.

single_user.note: Frontier hidden in Single user unless enabled in Settings (spec 4.1). GST display defaults incl per spec 6.13; acceptance tests are computed ex-GST (docs/decisions.md D3).

small_business.note: Band shift at 20 users switches tariff, hardware market, admin and PUE (spec 3.1).

lines: Estimates, not measurements. Speeds come from a bandwidth model calibrated to published benchmarks. Read the low/high band, not just the middle.
Model size is a proxy for capability. Quality targets and bands are indicative.
Same job, different token counts. Smaller models need more tokens and attempts. The efficiency factor is an assumption.
Subscription allowances are not published and change often. Replace the default with your own experience.
Prices move, in both directions and fast. All prices are dated snapshots. Secondhand prices vary widely and exclude postage.
DIY assumed for individuals. Turn on paid help if you can't set it up yourself. Organisations include admin labour by default.
Secondhand risk: no warranty, possible early failure, uncertain supply.
Long unattended runs: smaller models are more likely to drift or fail on long agentic tasks. Capacity is not the same as useful output.
Shared machines slow down under load. Per-user speed at peak is shown; batching needs a suitable serving engine.
Not modelled: heat, noise, space, troubleshooting time beyond the admin setting, internet outages, security patching.
Data location is not just a cost. The sensitivity rules are a screen, not a privacy assessment.
Not financial or tax advice. GST and depreciation treatment depend on your circumstances.

presets.label: LocoLabo defaults (this spec)
presets.description: Restores every parameter to the spec v0.3 and data pack defaults, reversing any edits.

presets.label: Picker snapshot prices (18 Apr 2026)
presets.description: Band AUD per GB derived from the picker snapshot mid prices: small modern 381.15/12, large modern 766.15/24, flagship 1433.74/24, legacy server 254.1/24. Flagship caveat: the picker bracket is a floor (spec 15 item 2), so 59.74 is a lower bound for the flagship band price.
presets.note: Snapshot prices without postage; secondhand availability varies.

presets.label: Pessimistic for local
presets.description: Local hardware looks as bad as the bands allow: hot draw at nameplate share 0.75, short secondhand life, high reserve, weak CPU path, expensive cards, generous subscriptions and falling API prices.
presets.note: Scenario preset for the sensitivity story, not a prediction.

presets.label: Optimistic for local
presets.description: Local hardware looks as good as the bands allow: cool draw 0.45, five-year life, low reserve, strong CPU path, cheap cards, stingy subscriptions and sticky API prices.
presets.note: Scenario preset for the sensitivity story, not a prediction.
